newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura underwrites 1.6 mln Polish Impexmetal shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nomura underwrites 1.6 mln Polish Impexmetal shrs.

text.p: Investment bank Nomura International Plc underwrote 1,594,586 shares of the initial public offering of Polish metals trader Impexmetal SA, Impexmetal said in a statement on Tuesday.
Impexmetal said Nomura agreed to take the shares at 36 zlotys and said no stand-by fee or discount from the issue price was envisaged.
The company started its initial public offer of 3,189,171 shares at 36 zlotys per share on Monday and the treasury ministry offers 2,976,560 of its 7,441,400 shares at the minimum price of 36 zlotys.

Under the underwriting agreement Impexmetal was obliged to limit by the end of May its liabilities to $51.3 million and to keep them at or below this level as long as Nomura holds 10 percent or more Impexmetal shares.
Impexmetal also agreed to consult all major equity investments and acquisitions with Nomura as long as it held at least 10 percent of Impexmetal.
